title: MEIKO — To Be More And More Supportive〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: To Be More And More Supportive（2★）
meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome back from your iHaz shoot, girls♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, how'd it go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It went really well.
They went off-script a few times, but we managed somehow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku especially.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! She was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
But I think you did a wonderful job answering their questions considering it was your first time on TV, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. You responded well while using your own words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It was all thanks to MEIKO practicing with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, you two practiced together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, way more than that!
We practiced over and over until I got it right...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're very welcome♪
I'm glad I could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That just leaves me learning how to answer and deal with questions that aren't in the script...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you mentioned that you went off-script a few times.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually I'm interested in hearing more about how your shoot went. Would you mind telling us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, not at all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to when it airs!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Promise to show us when it does, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was asked some questions that weren't in the script and I sort of panicked.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I tried coming up with a bunch that I thought I was gonna be asked, but none of them actually came up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We were just as surprised as you.
I really don't think there was much you could do about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I came up with some questions that aren't in the script that I think they're going to ask us! Would you mind taking a look at them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'd love to hear any that you come up with that you think I missed!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Even after Minori came to ask for my help...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Would I have been able to give her better advice if I had a better understanding of “raw interactions” or how idols and such are presented on TV...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh, speaking of which...we...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm? MEIKO...?
You seem concerned about something.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, there is something on my mind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Say, would you all mind listening for a second?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's wrong, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just realized something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We primarily focus only on doing shows, yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, yeah...
I mean, we have all these stages to work with...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Some parts do resemble what you might see in a TV studio, but we have hardly any experience doing shoots and such.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which probably isn't a good thing if we're going to support the girls moving forward, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's right. They might be asked to appear on TV more and more in the future.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, they managed to figure out a way this time, but it sounded like they still struggled.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. So you're saying that we should find a way to become more familiar with the world of TV, right♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a rough idea of what music programs that involve live performances are like, but there's more than just that, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Travel programs, variety shows and such... We don't normally get exposed to them, but there is a chance that Minori and the others will.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we go on a trip?
We can even try some delicious food and give reviews about them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. SEKAI's a very big and expansive place, so there may be stages that we haven't discovered yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Giving food reviews also sounds fun.
I'm very much looking forward to doing that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The girls have set their sights very, very high.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Which is why I'd like to give them all the support I can. So that they can achieve their goal.)
